text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Accel Construction Management Incorporated is constructing a 12-storey residential condominium building at 200 St. Clair Avenue West. The site is located on the north-east quadrant of St. Clair Avenue West and Forest Hill Road. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the east sidewalk on Forest Hill Road abutting the site for a period of 26 months. Pedestrian movements on the east side of Forest Hill Road abutting the site will be restricted. A temporary pedestrian walkway along the closed portion of the east sidewalk could not be installed due to insufficient roadway width to maintain both the temporary walkway and two-way traffic operations on Forest Hill Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved closure of the east sidewalk on Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West and a point 40.5 metres north, from June 13, 2018 to July 31, 2020. 2. Directed the applicant to post a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 3. Directed the applicant to provide and install public art, including mural artwork, onto every elevation of the hoarding board with adequate spotlighting for night-time illumination, at their sole cost, to the satisfaction of the Ward Councillor. 4. Directed that Forest Hill Road be returned to its pre-construction conditions when the project is completed.
